title: Capricorn: your 2027,
month by month.
summary: A year of becoming someone new. The five chapters of a Capricorn year, what each month is for, and the dates to know.
imageAlt: Maya holding a Capricorn flag, with a sea-goat beside her
inside: The year in five chapters, each with what to do and what to avoid
Work, love, money, energy and home, one by one
All twelve months, with your best months marked
The dates that matter, and why the year reads this way
intro: If you are a Capricorn by Moon sign, 2027 is the year you change shape. A restless, hungry influence sits on your own sign from December 5, 2026 and stays all year, and the tradition reads that as a strong appetite for a new look, new goals and a new way of being seen.

Around that, the year is kind to you. Your partnerships are warmly supported in the first half, your own effort is read as paying off for most of the year, and the year closes with luck widening into travel, teachers and big ideas. The middle of the year asks for some patience at home, and gives you the chance to set it up properly.

chapters.name: Settling into the new you
chapters.text: The year opens with the restless influence already on your sign, and luck sitting in your house of deep change. It is a private, inward three weeks: good for research, for looking honestly at what you want next, and for sorting out shared money and joint plans. You may feel the pull to reinvent yourself before you know exactly into what. That is normal at the start of a long stretch like this.
chapters.do: Write down what you would change about your life if nobody was watching, and keep the list.
chapters.avoid: Making a dramatic change on impulse in the first week of the year.

chapters.name: Warm company
chapters.text: Luck moves into your house of partners, in the sign where it is traditionally at its strongest. This is read as one of the warmest stretches for love, marriage, business partners and close friendships that you will have in a long time. At the same time, the planet of effort sits in your house of courage, a place the tradition counts among its best, so whatever you push for with steady work tends to move. Good company and real effort together: this is the heart of your year.
chapters.do: Say yes to the right partner, in love or in work, and put your effort into something you share.
chapters.avoid: Keeping people at a distance out of habit. This is the season to let them in.

chapters.name: Fixing the base
chapters.text: The planet of patience steps into your house of home and family. The tradition reads this as a time when home asks for attention: repairs, a move, a parent who needs you, or simply the feeling that your base has to be sorted before you can go further. It is slow work, and it is worth doing well. From June 25 luck also leaves your house of partners for your house of deep change, so the mood turns more private.
chapters.do: Fix the thing at home you have been putting off, one step at a time.
chapters.avoid: Treating a slow month at home as a sign that the year has gone wrong.

chapters.name: Effort pays again
chapters.text: The planet of effort returns to your house of courage, and the pressure on home eases. You feel more able to act, to speak up and to start things. Luck is still in your house of deep change, which suits finishing, researching and tidying up shared plans. These five weeks are a good time to use the energy that came back.
chapters.do: Pick up the project you paused in June and push it forward.
chapters.avoid: Spreading your effort over too many new starts at once.

chapters.name: Horizons open
chapters.text: Luck moves into your house of luck itself: teachers, travel, study and big ideas. It is read as a generous, opening end to the year, when your world gets bigger. With your courage supported too, December is a good month to plan a trip, sign up to learn something, or ask a mentor for advice.
chapters.do: Book the trip, start the course, or ask the person whose advice you trust.
chapters.avoid: Spending the month only catching up on old work.

allYear: The restless influence on your sign all year is read as a big appetite for change. Point it at one or two goals you really want, and keep your old friends close while you try on the new you.

areas.name: Work and career
areas.text: Your effort is well placed for most of the year, and the tradition reads that as work that pays off when you keep at it. You may want a new role or a new image at work; the first half of the year, with partners supporting you, is the better time to make that move.

areas.name: Love and relationships
areas.text: Late January to early June is the strongest stretch for love in years, with luck in your house of partners. A detached, calm influence also sits in that house all year, so say what you feel out loud; people may not guess it.

areas.name: Money
areas.text: Shared money and joint plans are in focus early in the year and again from late June to late November. Read the fine print on anything joint, and let the year's restlessness show up in ideas rather than sudden spending.

areas.name: Energy and wellbeing
areas.text: You have plenty of drive this year, and it can run ahead of rest. A steady routine helps you carry the change without feeling scattered, especially in the busy first half.

areas.name: Home and family
areas.text: June to October is when home asks for you. Repairs, a move or time with family are all read as part of the work of this stretch. Do it slowly and it lasts.

areas.name: Travel and learning
areas.text: The last five weeks of the year are your best for travel and study, with luck in your house of teachers and journeys. A short trip earlier in the year also suits your house of courage.

months.text: The year opens inward and private. Use the first three weeks to think about who you want to become. From the 24th luck moves into your house of partners and the mood warms.
Partners, in love and in work, are well supported. A good month to commit to someone or something you share. Your own effort also moves things along.
Still one of the warmest months of your year. Meet people, say yes to the right invitation, and put real work into a joint plan. Steady work on a shared goal moves well.
Good for agreements, weddings, contracts and teams. Your courage is high, so it is a good month to speak up for what you want. Agreements made now are read as sound.
The last full month of the partnership stretch. Finish what you started together, and look at what home will need from you next month. Keep showing up for the people you chose.
On the 2nd the focus moves to home and family, and on the 25th luck leaves your house of partners. The month starts social and ends quieter.
Home asks for attention. Good for repairs, a move, or time with a parent. Slow steady work at home is what this month rewards. Small fixes add up over the coming months.
Keep going with the home project. It can feel slow; that is the nature of this stretch. A quiet evening of planning does more than a rushed weekend.
A good month to settle family matters and make your space work for you. The tradition reads patience here as the thing that makes the result last.
Until the 18th the focus is still home. From the 19th your drive returns and you feel ready to act again. Pick the project you paused and restart it.
Effort pays again, and you have the energy to show it. From the 26th luck moves into your house of teachers and journeys, so the month ends opening up.
A generous end to the year. Plan a trip, start a course, or ask a mentor for advice. Your world is read as getting bigger this month. Close the year by saying thank you to the people who helped.

dates.text: The restless influence moves onto your sign and stays through all of 2027.
Luck moves into your house of partners. The warmest stretch of the year begins.
The focus turns to home and family until October 18.
Luck leaves your house of partners for your house of deep change.
Your drive returns to your house of courage, and home asks less of you.
Luck moves into your house of teachers and journeys for the end of the year.

why.name: Jupiter, the planet of luck and growth
why.text: Jupiter is in Leo, your eighth house of deep change, until January 23. It moves into Cancer, your seventh house of partners and the sign where it is exalted, from January 24 to June 24. It returns to Leo from June 25 to November 25, then enters Virgo, your ninth house of luck, teachers and travel.

why.name: Saturn, your sign's ruler
why.text: Saturn rules Capricorn. It is in Pisces, your third house of courage and effort, from January 1 to June 1 and again from October 19. The third house from the Moon is one of the places the tradition reads Saturn's transit as helpful. From June 2 to October 18 it moves forward into Aries, your fourth house of home.

why.name: Rahu and Ketu, the Moon's nodes
why.text: Rahu entered Capricorn, your own sign, on December 5, 2026, and stays there all of 2027, leaving in June 2028. Rahu on the Moon sign is read as hunger for change and a new identity. Ketu sits opposite in Cancer, your seventh house, which adds a calm, detached note to partnerships.

faq.q: Is this for my Sun sign or my Moon sign?
faq.a: Your Moon sign. Vedic astrology reads timing from the sign the Moon was in when you were born, which is often different from the Sun sign most people know.

faq.q: I'm a Capricorn Sun. Does this apply to me?
faq.a: Only if your Moon is also in Capricorn. Many people with a Capricorn Sun have their Moon somewhere else. Your birth chart shows it in a few seconds.
They are calculated from the planets' real positions, in US Eastern time, and they are the same for everyone with this Moon sign. What they mean for you in detail depends on the rest of your chart.

note: Dates are US Eastern time. Vedic (sidereal) astrology, read by Moon sign.
